title: Junior UX Designer
description:
About the role
We are hiring a Junior UX Designer for our Design team (Remote (US/EU)).

What you will do
- Work with developers to ship accessible interfaces
- Maintain and extend the design system
- Plan and run user research and usability tests
- Design user flows, wireframes and prototypes

What you bring
- No professional experience needed; internships and personal projects count
- Solid working knowledge of User Research, Visual Design, Design Systems, Prototyping and Usability Testing

Nice to have
- Accessibility, Information Architecture and HTML
